mathematical_review: Each P mode has exactly the recorded left/right final-edge requirements by conserved threshold weight.
The crossing P pattern and one previous S bit capture every future effect; relative edge tuples remain canonically ordered by insertion, so state merging is sound.
The six possible span-three crossing edges have exactly15 matching subsets, hence30 states with the final-edge bit.
Fixed actual-prefix completeness uses the cited nonredundant ending theorem. Arbitrary families need the stated span bound; the saved counterexample correctly distinguishes these scopes.
Reconstruction uses one predecessor per boundary state, without recursive suffix copying. Preprocessing is O(n times number of binary cut states), then decision and reconstruction are O(n).
